My hands will get clammy and I feel anxious and start shaking. I find it difficult to sleep
when I'm in bed. I get kind of agitated and I'll start thinking about all of the things that went
wrong at work or things that colleagues said to me. Well, perhaps I feel a bit paranoid. I don't know.
I just think it's really not worth all these side effects.
I suppose I engage in my former OCD behaviour less as a result of the medication,
but I think that might just be because I'm spending my time worrying about everything else.
It's like I've just swapped my former habits for new ones.
I'm compulsive about different things now, like stressing at night,
at least before my OCD was only impacting parts of my day.
These drugs, though, are making my life so much more difficult.
